ValidationRule.description: Requires that fields on the account be populated before moving an agency opportunity to the New Business Meeting stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.Name= "Agency"&& Account.RecordType.DeveloperName= "Agency"&& $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator"&& ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won")&& OR( ISPICKVAL(Account.LMS__c,"" ), ISPICKVAL(Account.Rater__c,"" ), ISBLANK(Account.Years_as_an_Agent__c), ISPICKVAL(Account.Track_Metrics__c, ""), ISBLANK(Account.Selling_Producers__c), ISPICKVAL(Account.Business_Strategy__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Account.Has_Defined_Sales_Process__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Account.Buys_Weekend_Leads__c, ""), ISBLANK(Account.Target_Monthly_Policies__c), ISBLANK(Account.Total_Leads_Purchased_Monthly__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: One or more agency fields are not populated on the account for this opportunity. Please go to the account to update the fields.
